Mediatorium & œconomicum est, quod ut Χριστός, Mediator &

page.notes: Marginal notes read: "Causa Regia potestatis Christi." and "Regnum Christi Mediatorium est, ab essentiali sola ratione distinctum." Greek word "Χριστός" in paragraph LXIV approximates the printed Greek ("Jesus Christus" form). Printed last word "creaturas" is continued on the line below ("ras,"). Some words in the lower-right are faint and uncertain.
